notes.title: Daily Login Reward! Update v2.99
notes.content:
New Content

 📅 Daily Login Reward: Free Paraverse Points!
Log in once a day to claim your free 500 Paraverse Points. 💪

You don't need to wait 24 hours before claiming your next daily login reward; you can simply login once a day any time between your local 12AM to 11:59PM. 
Don't worry about missing any days - there is no streak system, the next time you log in, you'll get your reward.

Balancing and Improvements 

 Reworked the visuals and homing behaviour of the Seeking Arrows Effect
 Slightly nerfed Sweeping Dash Effect's tile radius over levels 3/4/5/6/7 -> 3/3.5/4/4.5/5

You can claim your Daily Login Reward simply by opening the game.

notes.title: Balancing & Fixes - Small Update
notes.content:
Welcome, welcome, cube heroes!

Just a quick balancing & fixes update.

Balancing and Improvements 

 Made skills not use Mana in Safezone maps! Now, you can practice trying out combos against the dummy without any downside
 Changed "Mods" text in Pause and Mods menu to say "Power-ups"
 Slightly reduced basic attacks animation speed (attack speed is same)
 Slightly nerfed Demon mini boss's wave skill's projectile speed
 Disabled FPS display counter by default (you can toggle it on in Settings > Display category)

notes.title: Meta Progression Is Finally Here! Update v2.97
notes.content:
Permanent stat increases are finally in. 
Oh, and say hi to Toren!

New Content

 🚀 META PROGRESSION: With Paraverse Points!
Now, every time you play a session, your total score is added to a new currency called Paraverse Points. You can use Paraverse Points in the new Progression menu to permanently increase your base stats. Get ready to become a true Cube Hero. 💪
 🧴 New Merchant: Toren, The Healing Harbringer
Players asked, and we delivered. Toren has traveled far and wide, journeying with his large backpack of potions. He now joins the cast alongside Wesley and the crew on the reward maps, offering his healing services (HP and Mana) in endless supply—just be sure you've got the gold!

Balancing and Improvements 

 Changed dodge-roll, when playing with keyboard/mouse, to roll towards your mouse instead of the character's forward direction

 Bug Fixes and Optimizations

 Fixed a bug where clicking on an item on a chest window made it disappear which was misleading. The items are to show you all the loot you found, you get everything in the chest
 Fixed tutorial tips to stop appearing after you've turned them off with the tutorial toggle


View Progression Menu from Main Menu:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991809/09f693f531e2be488987eb594af499f2f65f3152.png

Use your Paraverse Points to permanently increase your base stats:
(Get more Paraverse Points from playing more sessions!)

With meta progression finally in, making every playthrough stronger than the last, and a long-awaited healer ready to aid you in your journey—dive in now and experience the evolved Cube Hero Odyssey.

notes.title: Twin-stick Gameplay Is Here! Update v2.9
notes.content:
Twin-stick Is Here!

New Content

 🎮  Twin-stick Gameplay: Whether you're a mouse & keyboard addict, or a controller fanatic, you can now aim n' shoot seamlessly twin-stick style. This gives you more control over your attacking and makes gameplay smoother and more dynamic.
 🖥️ Mini Effects HUD: Added a mini HUD (right below your Health bar) to display any active duration-based Effect mods. Whether it's an effect lasting X seconds or triggered by X hits, you'll be able to track these buffs easily in real-time.
 Revamped portions of the UI and added Controls Display to give the game a fresh new look. Menu screens are easier to navigate than ever, and show you which controls to use, based on what device you're playing on (keyboard vs controller)!

Balancing and Improvements 

 🎮  Massively improved controller support, a few kinks to work out here and there, but you can now almost exclusively play the whole game with your controller
 🎛️ Integrated full controls rebinding! Change your controls to whatever feels best! Our new controls UI revamp makes it easier than ever to rebind controls.


 We've been away for a while, but have been hard at work making the game better! 
The changes in this update have long been planned on our roadmap we released in the last developer update. 
If you haven't already, please wishlist the game on Steam! ⭐ 

This update is live! As always, if you encounter any bugs or issues, feel free to drop a message anywhere, here or our Steam/Discord discussion boards!

notes.title: Developer Update! July 12, 2024
notes.content:
Hello cube heroes!

A quick Developer Update.

Updates are right around the corner, stay tuned!
We hope you've been enjoying your adventures in our world of Cube Hero Odyssey. We wanted to give you a quick update on why things have been a bit quieter than usual on the development front lately.

One of our lead developers is getting engaged next week! 💍 This is an incredibly exciting time for us, and it has understandably taken up quite a bit of our focus as you can probably imagine. 

But don't worry – we're still hard at work behind the scenes, and you can expect some exciting updates coming your way. We have some great new features, and content already in the oven, cooking all this while, reading to be on your plate very soon!

The aforementioned features/content that is coming has been outlined in our last Developer Update:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2954730/view/4262175798108010989?l=english

in summary, the following items are the priority on our roadmap that will be coming next to the game and demo:

 Twin-stick Gameplay: being able to use your Mouse for aiming & attacking, Keyboard only for moving
 Controls Rebinding: this is actually already in the game! We'll be adding it for Twin-stick controls soon
 Meta Progression: loot & rewards that stay with you permanently, and make your next run easier and better
 More Diversity in Combat Combos: ways to make your basic attack combo different, and add more to it!
 Customization Of Character: ways to change your look, and try different weapons
 Gameplay Changes: lots of changes planned here, but one example is the way Healing works will be changed to allow players to collect potions and use them as actives, instead of instantly heal from chests

We really appreciate your patience! The passion and feedback from you guys fuels us to keep working hard and make the game much, much better. Keep those feedback discussions posts coming!

That's all for now! 
Don't forget to wishlist the game if you haven't already to stay notified of our upcoming full release!

notes.title: Cube Hero Odyssey DEMO is out!
notes.content:
Hello cube heroes!

It was time for another Developer Update!

Early Access Complete!
As some of you know, we went through an Early Access phase in May - June, and have since completed that phase. We're currently approaching and preparing the Full Game release!

During the Early Access phase, we took a TON of feedback, and loved hearing what cool, new stuff you would like to have added in the game. 

Even though Early Access is over, feedback and suggestions are still welcome! Feel free to post anytime on the game's discussion boards. 

A Free DEMO?!
As we transition into Full Game release...
It felt right to let some of our players continue to enjoy a sample of the game in the meantime!

There's so many more bosses, levels and new Mod effects that we've added that the Full Game will have, but will be restricted away in the demo, but the demo will surely give you a taste of the game's full potential.

What's On Our Roadmap?
There's been quite a few suggestion and feedback posts from players, which has been amazing! We really appreciate you taking the time to write a post, and thank you for playing.

These are some of the tasks on our roadmap to implement and push to the game and demo:

 Twin-stick Gameplay: being able to use your Mouse for aiming & attacking, Keyboard only for moving
 Controls Rebinding: this is actually already in the game! We'll be adding it for Twin-stick controls soon
 Meta Progression: loot & rewards that stay with you permanently, and make your next run easier and better
 More Diversity in Combat Combos: ways to make your basic attack combo different, and add more to it!
 Customization Of Character: ways to change your look, and try different weapons
 Gameplay Changes: lots of changes planned here, but one example is the way Healing works will be changed to allow players to collect potions and use them as actives, instead of instantly heal from chests


That's it for now! 
Lots of stuff coming in hot very soon. 
For now, please enjoy the demo! And let us know what you think.


As always, wishlist the game to be notified of the Full Release!

notes.title: Cube Hero Odyssey Early Access DONE!
notes.content:
Hello cube heroes!

You may have noticed the game is unplayable right now, and that's because:

We're transitioning to Full Release!
We made the Early Access available to play for a short time for free, and received lots of feedback! We've since made tremendous amount of changes both to the Early Access version of the game, and a great amount of secret new content for the Full Release.
The Full Release will be coming out Summer 2024 (in the next few months).

Those who played Early Access will get the Full Release game for free!

The demo will be similar to the Early Access version, but with a lot of content being hidden/restricted.

Please wishlist the game to be notified of the Full Release!

notes.title: Mana Resource and Skills Update v2.16
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991809/06933708d745c8add22425e84f685967af42f401.png
New Content
Mana Resource System (for Skills) 🌀

 We've changed the required resource to use Skills away from Energy to a new resource called 'Mana'. Unlike Energy, Mana does not auto-regenerate. There will be ways to recover Mana by means of chest loot, Effect mods, or by purchasing Mana recovery from a merchant.
 Energy will only be used for Dashing (and perhaps Attacking in the future).
 This change is a slight nerf to Skills because players won't use them the same way anymore, and to balance that, we've made heavy balancing changes to Skills (shown below), like buffing their damage and reducing their cooldown and mana cost.
 Chests now have a chance to provide a Mana Recover to the user (similar to Weak Heal, and Strong Heal).
 Added a review window after gameplay.

Balancing and Improvements

 Azurite Infusion: duration 25 -> 35, cost 90 -> 25
 Flow State: duration 15 -> 25, cost 90 -> 30
 Blade Whirl: cooldown 7s -> 5s, 0.5x Attack -> 0.65x Attack damage
 Descending Thrust: cost 30 -> 10, cooldown 8s -> 5s, 1.5x Attack -> 1.6x Attack damage
 Lightning Bolt: cost 30 -> 10, cooldown 5s -> 3.5s, 30 + 0.8x Ability -> 35 + 0.9x Ability damage
 Moonlight Slash: cost 30 -> 10, cooldown 6s -> 3.5s, 20 + 1.2x Ability -> 25 + 1.25x Ability damage
 Regal Crescent: cost 30 -> 15, cooldown 9s -> 4s, 40 + 0.95x Ability -> 50 + 0.95x Ability damage
 Stealth Step: cost 10 -> 5, cooldown 5s -> 3s
 Vagabond Bloodline changed to recover 5% Mana in addition to 5% Health every new round
 Pioneer Bloodline changed to provide 50 extra Mana, instead of 100 extra Energy
 Increased Chests located around the map per round from 3 -> 4!


Thank you for playing! If you've been enjoying Cube Hero Odyssey, and would like to support the game, please leave a review on our Steam page! Your reviews mean a lot to us and the game!

Wishlist the game to be notified of the Full Game Launch coming in Summer 2024!

It's been a bit over 2 weeks since Cube Hero Odyssey was released in Early Access. There's been a lot of bug fixes, optimizations, balance changes, and new content added to this version since then!

 Added FPS options! You can find them in Main Menu/Pause Menu > Options > Settings

notes.content:
Auto-Targeting Update v2.14 - May 23, 2024

New Content

 🎯 Auto-Targeting System: since targeting is really critical, and players use it every few seconds anyway, we've decided to make closest enemies be targeted automatically. No more spamming shift every few seconds! 
 If an enemy is already targeted, pressing shift now will switch your target to another close enemy

Bug Fixes and Optimizations

 Increased the Attack Dash Length of the player's 2nd attack in the full 3-attack combo! No more missing your target just because they were a lil too far
 Enemies that get pushed off the map die much faster now, instead of after being 20 feet below ground

notes.title: Balance & Quality Update v2.11
notes.content:
Balance & Quality Update - May 12, 2024

New Content

 Blank Tomes added as a new item/currency
 These can be traded in to Galilee (spellbook master) in exchange for a Skill
 Ronny, the Prophesized Prodigy now provides a Blank Tome as a gift to the player instead of a random Skill

Balancing and Improvements 

 :exclamation: Removed Rare Tier chests from regular rounds
  Rare chests (silver chests) spawned with increasingly better chances as the rounds went on, and this can skew balance quickly now that we've allowed for much higher rounds to be possible 
 Changed Corrupt Demon to use boss-level stat growth as he's essentially a mini-boss. Previously, he was using default stat growth which made his HP and damage not scale well into higher rounds. Now he'll be more strong, as he was meant to be (oops)
 Fixed Mystic Dungeons to only be offered once per biome! This is how it was intended to be. Them appearing more than once was an error.
 Changed Azurite Infusion skill's damage calculation: reduced scaling 1.0 * Ability -> 0.8 * Ability. To compensate, the skill's base boost is increased from 15 -> 20.

Bug Fixes and Optimizations

 Fixed bug with bosses or minor enemies sometimes stepping over the player
 Fixed bug with tree objects having a ghost collider in one of the sides obstructing player's movement
 Added proper skill icons for Stealth Step and Descending Thrust

notes.title: BIG Content Update! v2.1
notes.content:
Ever wondered what that old stonehouse is doing there? 
There's one in every biome... Take the plunge, and discover!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991809/14bf137a6a75d4d19a229a3e29aba9badfe4d1a3.png

New Content

 Mystic Dungeon! - we won't spoil too much! Take the leap, and explore!

Balancing and Improvements

Stat Balancing Experimental Change:
 Changed Stat Mods to provide static numbers, instead of growing numbers:
 -> Attack mods changed from giving +1/1/2/4/6/... -> always giving +5 Attack
 -> Ability mods changed from giving +5/6/7/9/12/... -> always giving +12 Ability
 -> Health mods changed from giving +10/11/13/15/18/... -> always giving +20 Health
 This is a change made in an effort to bring the game to a more scalable state (and easily balanceable) as we grow the game with more biomes, and higher level enemies that need to be challenging to the player's growing power level.
 ❗This is an experimental change: we'll be play-testing and monitoring this change to see how it pans out.
 From Oslind's shop, Ultra Attack changed from giving +10 Attack -> +15 Attack
 From Oslind's shop, Ultra Ability changed from giving +25 Ability -> +35 Ability
 From Oslind's shop, Ultra Health changed from giving +50 Health -> +60 Health
 Increased Avatar State skill's overall Damage Boost 15% -> 20%
 Increased the speed of Avatar State skill's casting animation
 Buffed Regal Crescent skill's damage 30 + 90% Ability -> 40 + 95% Ability
 Buffed Lightning Bolt skill's damage 15 + 60% Ability -> 30 + 80% Ability
 Rework! Pioneer bloodline no longer provides +100 extra starting Gold
 Rework! Pioneer bloodline now provides a 30% Ability Boost from start!

We've made tremendous amount of updates to the game, but this is the first to be published on Steam. Join our Discord Server to see all our updates, see progress videos and more!
